architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Shared UI in src/components/. Tailwind for styling. React Router v6 for navigation. No state manager (useContext for global state if needed).

tickets.title: Landing page (src/pages/Landing.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch screen `sentra_security_reinvented` to React. Match layout, typography, colors, spacing exactly. Use Tailwind classes. Extract reusable components (HeroSection, FeatureGrid, CTA) to src/components/landing/.
acceptance_criteria: Accessible (semantic HTML, ARIA labels, keyboard nav)

tickets.title: Style guide and theme setup (src/styles/theme.js, src/styles/globals.css)
tickets.description: Extract design tokens from `obsidian_protocol_style_guide`. Create Tailwind config (tailwind.config.js) with colors, fonts, spacing, shadows. Define CSS variables for dynamic theming. Document usage in src/styles/README.md.
acceptance_criteria: All design tokens match Stitch screen
Tailwind classes cover all UI needs
Dark/light mode support via CSS variables
README explains how to extend theme

tickets.title: Reusable button and card components (src/components/ui/Button.jsx, src/components/ui/Card.jsx)
tickets.description: Build reusable Button and Card components from `component_showcase_buttons_cards`. Support all variants (primary/secondary, outlined/filled, sizes). Use Tailwind for styling. Add PropTypes for validation.
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover all variants and interactions

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Create app shell with navigation bar. Set up React Router v6 with routes for Landing page. Add 404 page. Ensure navigation works without full reload. Style nav bar to match design system.
